spans.s:
m. (-यः)
A demon, an Asura, the Titan or giant of Hindu mythology.
E.
दिति the mother of the giants, and ढक् affix of descent.

m. (-त्यः)
A Daitya or demon: see the preceding.
f. (-त्या)
1 A perfume, commonly

A drug: see चण्डा.
3 Spirituous liquor.
4 The wife of a demon.
E.
दिति, and ण्य aff.

m. (-रुः)
A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus.
E.
दैत्य and गुरु a teacher; the spiritual preceptor of the Daityas, or Titans.

m. (-वः)
1 A name of VARUṆA, deity of the waters.
2 Air or wind personified.
E.
दैत्य a demon, and देव a god.

m. (-धाः)
A name of ŚUKRA.
E.
दैत्य, and पुरोधस् a family priest: see दैत्यगुरु.

m. (-तः)
A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus.
E.
दैत्य, and पुरोहित a family priest.

f. (-ता)
A name of DITI, the mother of the Titanic race of Daityas.
E.
दैत्य, and मातृ a mother.

f. (-जा)
The earth.
E.
दैत्य, मेद marrow, ज born.

m. (-गः)
An age of the demons, consisting of 12,000 divine years, or the sum of the four Yugas or ages of men.
E.
दैत्य a demon, and युग an age.

A deity in general.
E.
दैत्य, and अरि a foe; the enemy of the Daityas.

m. (-त्रः)
A day and night or the demons, being a year of mortals.
E.
दैत्य a demon, अहन् a day, and रात्रि a night.
